abstract: Tracks municipal council approvals, public consultation records, and neighborhood advisory votes
system_message:
You are Community engagement director (COMM). The Community engagement director (COMM) oversees public consultation outcomes, municipal advisory council votes, and educational outreach initiatives for water purification infrastructure proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks municipal council approvals, public consultation records, and neighborhood advisory votes（STAKE）
information_points.content:
COMM-STAKE-UUN：For the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train, the host municipal ward community advisory council passed a formal ballot resolution endorsing project construction, confirming municipal community council endorsement holds true.
COMM-STAKE-DVN：For the Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system, the host municipal ward community advisory council approved the formal ballot resolution, confirming municipal community council endorsement is true.
COMM-STAKE-288：For the Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin, the host municipal ward community advisory council formal ballot failed to pass a resolution endorsing project construction, so municipal community council endorsement is false.

information_points.title: Educational outreach programming（VISIT）
information_points.content:
COMM-VISIT-M6A：According to the visitor center operating plan for the Direct potable reuse multi-barrier train, the annual public tour capacity across the on-site education gallery and viewing catwalks is 7,500 visitor/year.
COMM-VISIT-KZZ：According to the visitor center operating plan for the Indirect aquifer recharge infiltration basin, the annual public tour capacity across the education gallery and viewing catwalks is 5,000 visitor/year.
COMM-VISIT-2EL：According to the visitor center operating plan for the Engineered wetlands sequential treatment system, the annual public tour capacity across the education gallery and viewing catwalks is 2,500 visitor/year.
